elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: Clause warrants only that "the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation"; no professional-manner standard appears.

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: No workmanlike standard anywhere in 7.3; only "free from defects in materials and workmanship" as to media.
"will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation" — conformance is qualified by "substantial", not the preferred express conformance.
"for a period of twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1"
Single "Warranty Period" runs from acceptance of the Software; no separate 90-day services period is stated.
"shall take all commercially reasonable efforts to correct" — an efforts obligation, not an express repair remedy.
"if correction ... is reasonably not possible, replace such Software and MarketSite.net Service free of charge"
"Corio has the right to terminate this Agreement and receive a refund of all prepaid fees"
No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the redlined clause.
"is free of any willfully introduced computer virus, or any other similar harmful, malicious or hidden program or data"
"for a period of twelve (12) months" exceeds the 90-day fallback floor.
No separate services warranty or services duration is stated; the sole Warranty Period runs from Software acceptance.

elements.element: Same remedies (repair, replace, refund) at fallback
elements.evidence: Only "commercially reasonable efforts to correct", replacement, and refund on termination; express repair remedy absent.

offending_extra_words: from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1
reasons: The locked preferred level is not achieved: the redline fixes only duration. There is no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no separate 90-day services period, no compliance-with-laws warranty, and conformance remains qualified as "substantial accordance with the Documentation" rather than express conformance.
No express repair remedy: "commercially reasonable efforts to correct" is an efforts standard, so the repair leg of repair/replace/refund is unmet at both levels.
The fallback is also incomplete because a services warranty (30 days) and the repair remedy are absent, so the clause cannot be treated as sitting acceptably at the fallback.

Minimality fails: the operation rewrote the whole duration phrase and imported a new measuring trigger and cross-reference ("from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1") where changing "sixty (60) days" to "twelve (12) months" and deleting the December 31, 1999 sunset would suffice; the official minimality gate records a 0.767 changed-character ratio against a 0.600 limit.
Intent is preserved: the remedy stack, exclusivity, media warranty, malicious-code warranty and benefit-of-Corio language are untouched and no contradiction or dangling defined term is introduced.

Recommended fix: keep the numeric edit narrow and add a short insertion covering professional and workmanlike performance of the Services with a 90-day services warranty and an express "repair" remedy, plus a compliance-with-laws warranty.
